description: next/ v2.0 — ISA-95 physical asset / tooling (e.g. an injection mould, die, fixture). Neutral generalization of 'mould'. IMPLEMENTED_BY target of machine profiles; can be set up on an Unit.

properties.name: tool_type
properties.description: Type of tooling (e.g. mould, die, fixture).

properties.name: unit_ref
properties.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (IMPLEMENTATION_OF; Machine ≡ Unit level) — where the tool is currently set up.

properties.name: parts_per_shot
properties.description: Number of good parts ONE machine cycle yields with this tool: the mould's cavity count (moved here from ProductionOrder in core 3.0.0).

properties.name: storage_location_ref
properties.description: The StorageLocation (AT_LOCATION; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset → OperationalLocation). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (DEFINED_BY; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: parent_tool_ref
properties.description: The Tool this Tool is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset MADE_UP_OF PhysicalAsset). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset → TestSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_definition
properties.description: The spatial definition (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.2): the location or shape as text in spatial_format. Optional.

properties.name: spatial_format
properties.description: The format of spatial_definition (e.g. WKT). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_srid
properties.description: The spatial reference system of spatial_definition (SRID). Optional.

relationships.description: The machine the tool is currently set up on (Machine ≡ Unit level, consolidation 2026-07-15).

isa95.note: ISA-95 PhysicalAsset (tooling). IMPLEMENTED_BY target of machine profiles; neutral replacement for 'Mould'.
isa95.mappingNote: tool_type is a free-text kind (mould, die, fixture), no PhysicalAssetClass of the model; parts_per_shot (cavity count) is no field of B2MML PhysicalAsset. Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
